title: Runtime Contract
description: Declares how a service is started, what it depends on, and how it is health-checked. Used by SVC-* governance rules and estate tooling.

start_command.description: Shell command or module path to start the service. For python-venv interpreter, this is passed as args to the venv python (e.g. '-m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8020'). For node, this is the npm script name (e.g. 'serve'). For none, this is the full command (e.g. 'node src/server.js').

working_dir.description: Relative path from services.yml to the service root directory.

interpreter.description: Runtime interpreter. 'node' runs via npm, 'python-venv' activates the venv, 'go' runs a compiled binary, 'none' runs the start_command directly.

venv_path.description: Relative path from working_dir to the Python virtual environment. Required when interpreter is 'python-venv'.

env_file.description: Relative path from working_dir to the environment file loaded at startup.

env_overrides.description: Environment variables merged on top of env_file values. Useful for PORT or NODE_ENV overrides.

required_infra.description: Infrastructure keys from the 'infrastructure' block that must be running before this service starts (e.g. 'postgres', 'redis', 'kafka').

allowed_callers.description: Per D-036 / RULE-003 (SCP-R-006). Declares the set of estate service_ids permitted to invoke this service via ACC cross-repo dispatch. Each entry must match a service_id in the estate_repos.yaml registry. Optional; rule SCP-R-006 enforces presence + registry membership only when the adopter sets `.scp/rule-config.yaml acc-cross-repo-caller-scoped: true`.

required_services.description: App keys from the 'apps' block that must be running before this service starts (e.g. 'fashion-ontology-service' for the recommender).

health_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the healthcheck endpoint to return 200 after startup.

restart_policy.description: Restart behaviour. 'on-failure' restarts on non-zero exit, 'always' restarts unconditionally, 'none' does not restart.

max_restarts.description: Maximum consecutive restarts before the process manager marks the process as errored.

watch.description: Whether the process manager should watch for file changes and auto-restart. Usually false — active dev uses the terminal instead.

cron_restart.description: Optional cron expression for periodic restarts (e.g. '0 3 * * *' for 3am daily). Null means no scheduled restart.

auth_contract.description: Declares the estate-approved auth modes this service accepts. Presence is enforced by the service-lifecycle evaluator per SVC-003 (not by this schema's required list). See SVC-003 rule text for exemptions.
